cohort: 11 pregnant women diagnosed with cancer during pregnancy
finding: No major maternal toxicities or fetal malformations were observed in the patients included in the study.
mod_finding: 5 of the patients had a vaginal delivery and 5 had a caesarean section
gest_age: variable, but 3 babies whose mothers had chemotherapy for haematological malignancy were born prematurely and 1 pregnancy was ended in prematurity
